name: Church of Tal
description: Organized a crusade against Urza's former base.

description_citations.text: "Urza's Tower". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Raddic's crusade confronts Penregon and he issues an ultimatum to cast out the machines.
timeline.quote: Raddic issued an ultimatum: cast out the machines or face destruction.

citation.text: "Raddic", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Penregon's defenders repel the Talite assault on the walls.
timeline.quote: Penregon's defenders successfully repelled the Talite crusaders' assault on the city walls.

citation.text: "Raddic", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Infiltrated Talites attack the city but are quelled.
timeline.quote: quelling the insurgents through fierce street-to-street fighting

citation.text: "Raddic", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Talites raid Urza's Tower and march on Mishra's Fortress.
timeline.quote: they successfully raided Urza's Tower , leaving it stripped and abandoned

citation.text: "Raddic", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Scattered Third Path mages seek refuge from the Church of Tal after the falls of Terisia City and Lat-Nam, finding it in the City of Shadows and the Conclave.
timeline.quote: the Third Path was left without a base of operations, its members scattered across Terisiare

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal army led by Primate Delphine attacks the citadel while Jodah and Sima free Lord Ith.
timeline.quote: Jodah and Sima freeing Lord Ith from his cage.

citation.text: "Conclave of Mages", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Kayla rules Penregon, rebuilds with Tawnos's automatons, and the Church of Tal besieges the city.
timeline.quote: initiated the Siege of Penregon in 69 AR

citation.text: "Kayla bin-Kroog", section "Penregon". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tawnos helps Kayla defend Penregon against the Church of Tal's siege.
timeline.quote: helped her to defend the city against the Church of Tal 's Siege of Penregon later that year.

citation.text: "Tawnos", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the fall of the College of Lat-Nam, Drafna and other Third Path survivors found the City of Shadows in hiding from the Church of Tal.
timeline.quote: founded the City of Shadows

citation.text: "City of Shadows", section "Origin". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal rules the war-ravaged city-states and seeks to eradicate artifice and magic.
timeline.quote: the Church of Tal sought to eradicate them

citation.text: "Terisiare", section "Dark Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Goblin hordes on Terisiare are defeated in Tivadar's Crusade.
timeline.quote: Goblin hordes were causing problems here and there, but they were defeated in Tivadar's Crusade

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Dark Age". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Two Yotian sun-worshipping cults join to form the Church after the Sylex Blast.
timeline.quote: The Church formed when two Yotian sun-worshipping cults joined.

citation.text: "Church of Tal", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Raddic's Talites destroy the Monastery of Gix and begin their crusade.
timeline.quote: After destroying the Monastery of Gix

citation.text: "Church of Tal", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Talites fail in the Siege of Penregon.
timeline.quote: they began the unsuccessful Siege of Penregon in the spring of 69 AR

citation.text: "Church of Tal", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Church holds the city-states in an iron grip by 430 AR.
timeline.quote: By 430 AR, Tal had an iron grip on the city-states of the era.

citation.text: "Church of Tal", section "Origins". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Church prayers are found to be white spells and tolerance of mages grows.
timeline.quote: greater tolerance of magic users was fostered by this knowledge

citation.text: "Church of Tal", section "Hypocrisy and diminishing". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The School of the Unseen survives undetected through the Dark Age but must abandon the City of Shadows during the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: the School of the Unseen survived undetected into the Ice Age

citation.text: "Lat-Nam", section "School of the Unseen". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal attacks the Conclave and Barl organizes the counter-attack, killing one of its members.
timeline.quote: Barl organized the counter-attack.

citation.text: "Barl", section "The attack". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During a Church of Tal assault Jodah frees Ith, who rampages and kills Mairsil and the Rag Man, then is calmed by Jodah's mirror.
timeline.quote: Ith, who had been driven insane by his time over the Pit, go into a murderous rampage that resulted in the death of Mairsil and the Rag Man

citation.text: "Jodah", section "The Gathering Dark". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: After the Sylex Blast and the rise of the Church of Tal, remaining members go underground.
timeline.quote: forcing any remaining members of the Third Path to go underground

citation.text: "Third Path", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The First Talite Crusade purges the Gixian lands and destroys the Monastery of Gix.
timeline.quote: the nascent Church of Tal begins a crusade against artifice and magic

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Second Talite Crusade destroys the machines at Urza's Tower and Mishra's Fortress.
timeline.quote: They battle and destroy all of Mishra's machines there, at the cost of several lives

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal rises to dominance and its zealots wage crusades to eradicate arcane practice.
timeline.quote: Talite zealots waged crusades to eradicate lingering remnants of arcane practice

citation.text: "Dark Age", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Delphine raises an army of the Church of Tal and assaults the Conclave's citadel.
timeline.quote: After Primata Delphine raised an army of the Church of Tal against the Conclave of Mages , they assaulted the citadel.

citation.work: Fall of the Conclave of Mages
citation.text: "Fall of the Conclave of Mages", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crusade purges the Gixian lands and empties the Monastery of Gix.
timeline.quote: The first crusade of the Church began with a purge of the Gixian lands to the far north of Terisiare

citation.text: "First Talite crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The crusade marches through the old Fallaji Empire and the ruins of Kroog.
timeline.quote: The Talites then traveled through the ruins of Kroog

citation.text: "First Talite crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Talites liberate Korlis from a cruel machine overlord.
timeline.quote: the Talites liberated Korlis from this creature

citation.text: "First Talite crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Talites march to Penregon where planted agents await, leading to the Siege of Penregon.
timeline.quote: This led the way to the Siege of Penregon .

citation.text: "First Talite crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Tivadar of Thorn rallies the Church of Tal and, aided by Rasputin Dreamweaver, wages a crusade that decimates the goblin hordes.
timeline.quote: the goblin hordes had been decimated, retreating into their northern abodes

citation.text: "Flarg", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal liberates Korlis from a machine warlord after the war.
timeline.quote: After the war, the Church of Tal liberated Korlis from a machine warlord.

citation.text: "Korlis", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Church of Tal army attacks the Conclave; Mairsil drains Primata Delphine's defenses with the Wand of Ith and stabs her to death.
timeline.quote: after draining away her magical defenses with the

citation.text: "Mairsil", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Myrel reports on the approaching Church of Tal marchers, helping Kayla and Tawnos prepare defenses.
timeline.quote: Myrel provided vital intelligence on the movements and composition of the approaching column of marchers from the Church of Tal

citation.text: "Myrel", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal launches the Siege of Penregon and is beaten back by the civil automatons.
timeline.quote: which launched the Siege of Penregon but were beaten back

citation.text: "Penregon", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Talites regrouped after the failed siege and marched away vowing to return.
timeline.quote: marching away from the city while vowing to return at a later date

citation.text: "Second Talite crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Talites destroyed artifacts in Urza's Tower but left the building standing.
timeline.quote: the Talites instead destroyed any artifacts inside the tower but left the building itself standing

citation.text: "Second Talite crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Talites fought fiercely at Mishra's Fortress, killing the demons; Raddic died.
timeline.quote: The fighting there was fierce

citation.text: "Second Talite crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Talites returned to Penregon to find it abandoned.
timeline.quote: the civils that had once populated its streets had all left

citation.text: "Second Talite crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The second crusade ended with eastern Terisiare liberated.
timeline.quote: the second crusade ended

citation.text: "Second Talite crusade", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Sima falls into Delphine's trap in Alsoor and is imprisoned by the Church of Tal, slated for execution.
timeline.quote: Sima was thus imprisoned by the Church of Tal and was slated for execution.

citation.text: "Sima", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 430 AR Jodah and Voska are arrested and taken to Alsoor; Voska sacrifices himself and Jodah escapes with the Rag Man's help.
timeline.quote: Voska sacrificed himself to draw the Church of Tal 's attention away from Jodah, who managed to escape with the help of the Rag Man .

citation.text: "Southern City-States", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Jodah is trapped in plague-locked Ghed, exposed by Sima and the Church when his Alabaster Potion heals people, and joins Ghed's army to hide.
timeline.quote: To hide from the church, Jodah joined the army of Ghed in its war against Alsoor.

citation.text: "Southern City-States", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 450 AR the Church of Tal dissolves and the cold grips the continent, marking the official start of the Ice Age.
timeline.quote: 450 AR marks the official start of the era of ice

citation.text: "Start of the Ice Age", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Church of Tal crusade smashes the remaining machines in the tower but cannot damage its structure, and moves on toward Mishra's Forge.
timeline.quote: the crusaders instead moved on toward Mishra 's Forge

citation.text: "Urza's Tower", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Vervamon is burned at the stake by the Church of Tal.
timeline.quote: he was burned at the stake under suspicion of being a sorcerer

citation.text: "Vervamon", section "Biography". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.
